label: One represented essence value permits infinitely many distinct identity suppliers of one recipient
paraphrase: Analyst countermodel on the q3a4 profile with all naturals actual. Zero has distinct esse. The edge from c to x holds exactly when c = x + 1. All actual identity bearers have the same represented essence value, and infinitely many of them are ancestors of zero. Each distinct-esse bearer has identity ancestry and no identity bearer lies on an actual esse-cause loop. The universal finite root-audit condition and the common first-source conclusion both fail. The singleton counts values assigned by essenceOf.
